answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41380 Country: Bangladesh Title: Whether fasting breaks or not Question: Accidentally I delved into the trap of nafs and watched pornography in internet during fasting, Ramadan but refrained from masturbation or any sort of ejaculation. But when I was doing ablution for Zuhr prayer after the end of ablution I checked my penis and observed a tiny drop of liquid which could not be distinguished between drop of urine or a drop of ejaculation. Then again I started my ablution after cleansing that drop. For your kind information I want to add that I use to do ablution in such a way that usually my Punjabi pajama become wet by the water of ablution and so I am also confused regarding that tiny drop of liquid in penis whether this is due to the wetness of pajamas or not. My question is for those whether my fasting breaks or not and if fasting breaks what will I have to do for that? Note: I did taubah with tears to Allah Ta'ala for my sin and seek dua for me. Answer ID: 41380 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1322/1006/H=1433) (1) Your fast shall not be termed invalid due to this heinous act but it is major sin to see naked pictures. (2) It was a good that you did true taubah with tears in your eyes and supplicated Allah. In future do not commit such bad act as it includes the condition of true taubah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
